Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Coordinator role at Maasmechelen Village.

Coordination is where my work naturally sits. At Episto I run several client websites in parallel - CMS publishing, SEO content, reporting - keeping deadlines and stakeholders aligned. Before that, at KXP, I supported digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff), where cross-team alignment mattered as much as the build itself.

I'm comfortable in project management tools, CMS and CRM systems, Microsoft Office and Canva, I edit video in CapCut Pro, and I use AI tools daily to speed up reporting and routine admin. I don't let ambiguity slow a team down, and I prefer co-owning outcomes to handing off tasks.

English is fluent and Turkish native; my Dutch is at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, and I'm actively improving it.

I'd welcome the chance to talk.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

The Marketing Coordinator role at Maasmechelen Village reads like a description of how I already work: several projects open at once, a content calendar to keep honest, and a team that needs someone to notice a problem before it lands.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and I own the CMS side: publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media across WordPress, Elementor, Astra and Rank Math, plus Shopify stores where I manage the catalogue and blog content. That means parallel deadlines, several stakeholders, and constant switching between channels - the connective-tissue part of the job.

Before that, at KXP, I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market, with 4,000+ stores, and Aras Kargo, an application gallery for 12,000 staff. In projects that size, keeping people aligned and deliverables on schedule was the real work. I also build sites end to end myself, including mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran iterative technical audits that measurably raised its search-health score.

On tools: I'm comfortable in project management platforms, CMS and CRM systems, Microsoft Office, Canva and CapCut Pro, and I use AI tools daily to automate routine admin and speed up reporting. I track performance in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.

On languages, I want to be straight with you: English is fluent and Turkish is native, while my Dutch sits at B1 writing and A2+ speaking. I'm working on it deliberately, and I live in Zwijndrecht - a short drive from the Village.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can keep your campaigns and guest touchpoints moving.

Baver Ok
